---
title: "Geospatial assessment of Japanese encephalitis virus infection risk in Australia"
output: github_document
---

A repository of all code relating to the manuscript *Geospatial assessment of Japanese encephalitis virus infection risk in Australia*. This code was written by Lucinda Harrison, in collaboration with Freya Shearer, David Duncan, Nick Golding, Jennifer Flegg, and David Price. The data associated with this manuscript are not for circulation and are not attached in this repository.

Start at `top_to_bottom.R`:

```{r eval = FALSE}
source("code/pathogen_p2_sort_surveillance_data.R")
# ensure PROMOTE_SEROS is set to TRUE

source("code/pathogen_model.R")
# check whether intensity model fitting is turned off:
# the fitted model used in the manuscript is provided as an .rds in output/

source("code/pathogen_model_inputs_figure.R")
# this is making five pictures, which is more than you need
# requires top half of `pathogen_model` to have been run: 
# uses `dat` object of prepared data for model

source("code/ecdfs.R")
# does the pink maps and supporting supp figures

source("code/niche_extents_population_at_risk.R")
# does the neapolitan map and supporting table
```

(This script is not intended to be run unsupervised but can be used as a guide to navigate the repo.)

An older iteration of the model (prior to the incorporation of sentinel chicken data and diagnostic uncertainty) is included in `model_2022`.
